_nota: Blocos IMUTÁVEIS. O montador cola estes textos verbatim em todo plano. Adaptações em relação ao seu bloco de imagem estática: 'puppet' virou 'puppets' (dois personagens), e foram removidos 'ONE single character alone in frame', '50mm ... 4:5 vertical' (a câmera é definida por plano) e as linhas 'Pose:' de cada personagem (a pose vem da ação do plano).
ESTILO: Claymation plasticine stop-motion style. Handcrafted modelling clay puppets with visible fingerprints, tool marks and thumb-pressed texture, matte with gentle satin sheen, photographed on a miniature practical set.
SET_OFICINA: SET: interior of a small 1970s Czech suburban workshop. Cream stucco wall with damp stains, sloped ceiling with reddish exposed wooden beams, moss-green wooden casement window with white lace curtain on the left, worn wooden workbench on the right with an iron vise, hammer and loose nails, pegboard with hanging wrenches and pliers, wooden ladder leaning on the back wall, wooden floorboards with sawdust, tilted wooden crate, galvanised bucket, open paint tin, red watering can in the background. Soft diffuse overcast daylight through the window, warm colour temperature, soft short shadows.
JUCA: Claymation character JUCA, a Black handyman, 22cm puppet, 3.5 heads tall. Barrel torso, short stubby legs, oversized clay hands with four thick sausage fingers, small round ears. Slightly flattened spherical head. Dark warm brown matte clay skin #6B4226 with fingerprint texture. Short cropped hair built from many small black clay coils #1A1512, straight hairline, covering the crown and 1.5cm down the temples. Large bulbous terracotta round nose #8F4E33 projecting forward. Eyes: two small black clay dots 4mm, no sclera, one tiny white highlight each. Black clay eyebrows angled slightly inward. Mouth: single thin dark-brown clay line, gentle upward curve, faint lips, no teeth. Small jowls. Mustard knitted clay sweater #C98A2E with sculpted cable ribbing, round ribbed collar, ribbed cuffs and hem, grey-blue patch on left elbow; olive-green twill trousers #4E5A3C, marked seam, frayed rolled cuff; pale wooden clogs #C9A46B with brown leather strap; burnt-brown clay flat cap #6E3B22 tilted right, short brim; coiled yellow measuring tape #E8C23A from the trouser pocket; carpenter pencil behind right ear.
TEO: Claymation character TÉO, a white handyman, 24cm puppet, 3.8 heads tall, slim, slightly stooped. Narrow cylindrical torso, long thin limbs, oversized clay hands with four long slim fingers, protruding oval ears. Elongated oval head, broad forehead. Pale pinkish matte clay skin #EFC6A8. Bald smooth crown with subtle satin sheen #F0C9AB, two tufts of straw-blond clay hair #D9B26A above the ears, deep receding hairline. Pear-shaped nose with drooping tip, light terracotta #D98E6B. Eyes: two small black clay dots 4.5mm, no sclera, one tiny white highlight each. Straw-blond clay eyebrows arched outward. Large straw-blond clay moustache #C9A97A, 3.4cm wide, covering the whole upper lip, ends drooping below the mouth line; mouth hidden underneath, no teeth. Red and black checked flannel clay shirt #A8322A / #2B2320, small checks, pointed collar, five cream buttons, sleeves rolled twice; brown leather-look suspenders #5A3A22 with small brass buckles; khaki trousers #8C7A54, straight hem; dark brown lace-up boots #3E2A1C; teal knitted beanie #2F4F5E with two cream stripes #EFE4CE, folded twice, no pompom.
NEGATIVOS: No text, no logo, no watermark, no cartoon outlines, no anime eyes, no visible sclera, no teeth, no plastic gloss, no 2D vector, no CGI Pixar look, no extra fingers.
